title: AAC clause inventory and acquisition status
notes: Clause IDs below are the commonly cited MPEG-4 Audio / MPEG-2 AAC numbers. Field widths come from public amendment previews and independent parsers, not from a purchased standard copy. Do not treat this file as ISO text.

editions.title: ISO/IEC 14496-3 Information technology — Coding of audio-visual objects — Part 3: Audio

public_previews.title: ISO/IEC 14496-3:2005/Amd 2:2006 AudioSpecificConfig (HE-AAC / PS)
public_previews.used_for: Table 1.13 AudioSpecificConfig field order: AOT, samplingFrequencyIndex, channelConfiguration, then for AOT 5/29: extensionSamplingFrequencyIndex and inner GetAudioObjectType

editions.title: ISO/IEC 13818-7 MPEG-2 AAC, ADTS
editions.used_for: ADTS fixed+variable header cited in src/engine/adts.rs as §1.A.2.2; multi-block CRC region still needs the standard

editions.title: ISO/IEC 11172-3:1993 MPEG-1 audio CRC-16
editions.used_for: ADTS crc_check identity: G(x)=x^16+x^15+x^2+1, not the MPEG-4 Audio §1.8.4.5 family used by LATM StreamMuxConfig

editions.title: ISO/IEC 14496-26:2024 Audio conformance
editions.used_for: official pass/fail bitstreams; abstract does not supply numeric limits

editions.title: ISO/IEC 14496-12 ISO base media file format
editions.used_for: M4A boxes, 32-bit sizes, elst; in-tree isomp4.rs / m4a_write.rs

independent_parsers.used_for: explicit AOT 5/29 consumes samplingFrequencyIndex then extensionSamplingFrequencyIndex; implicit 0x2b7 reads extension rate and 0x548 PS
latm_get_value = 2-bit bytesForValue then (n+1)*8 bits; numSubFrames 6 bits; StreamMuxConfig program/layer checks
GASpecificConfig parses program_config_element when channelsConfiguration==0; CCE Table 4.4.8 field order; PCE field list
LatmGetValue 2-bit length; same lineage must not be the only oracle (DOC-3)

topics.syom: src/engine/asc.rs: explicit AOT 5/29 reads one rate and halves it; implicit 0x2b7 sets sbr_present but does not consume extensionSamplingFrequencyIndex or 0x548
parse_ga skips PCE; in-band PCE is parsed later from raw_data_block
AdtsHeader parses the count; decode_raw_mono_f32 / decode_raw_data_block ignore _num_raw_data_blocks
protection_absent==0 skips 16 bits; CRC not checked. LATM uses a different CRC (14496-3 §1.8.4.5), already in src/engine/crc.rs
latm_value is 8-bit+escape, not 2-bit bytesForValue; numSubFrames and allStreamsSameTimeFraming are read and ignored; one payload extracted

topics.acquisition: faad2-field-list; layout order is a product choice (lavc vs MPEG speaker labels)
topics.syom: parse_pce exists; object_type and sf_index discarded; missing PCE slots become silence; extras appended; config>=7 identity order

clauses: 14496-3 AAC maximum bit reservoir / 6144 bits per channel for LC (commonly cited)
topics.acquisition: public-decoder-consensus; exact profile/level tables need full 14496-3
topics.syom: encoder caps ADTS payload at 8184 bytes by dropping top bands, not a per-channel 6144-bit check
skip_cce consumes a different field order and does not apply gains
